abstract.para: Learn how to use the Activities overview, the Clock and Calendar features and the System menu.

section.title: Activities overview
section.para: The Activities overview shows a preview of all open windows and icons for favorite and running applications. It also integrates searching and browsing.

textobject.phrase: &gnome; Desktop view displaying the top panel, active window overview, search input field and application dash at the bottom

itemizedlist.title: Opening the Activities overview
itemizedlist.para: To open the Activities overview, you have the following options:

listitem.para: Click the Activities button in the left corner of the top bar.
Move the mouse pointer to the upper-left hot corner.
Press the key on your keyboard.
Use the search box at the top to find applications, settings and files in your home directory.
To search, you do not need to click the search box. Start typing right after opening the Activities overview. Search runs as you type, with no need to press .

The dash is the bar at the bottom center. It contains your favorite applications and running applications. Hover over an icon to see the application name. A small dot underneath the icon indicates that the application is running.
Right-click an icon for application-specific actions. Use Pin to Dash to keep an application icon permanently in dash. To remove a program icon from dash, select Unpin. Drag icons to rearrange them.

section.title: Clock and Calendar
section.para: Click the clock on the top bar to see the current day and time. If you use Calendar or another supported calendar application, it also shows your upcoming appointments and notifications.

section.title: System menu
section.para: Click the icons in the top-right corner to open the System menu. From here, you can adjust volume and brightness, manage network and power settings, take a screenshot, lock the screen, switch users, log out or shut down.
